decisions.expression_status: indexed GSM expression snippets encountered before scope; full matrix subsequently opened under separate diagnostic scope
decisions.decision: 42 profiles, seven arms with six source-labeled biological repeats each, three canonical pairs at source-matched doses and six hours. No independent-initiation block map or vehicle fraction established. Accepted only for an unmatched-arm descriptive processed-assay diagnostic.

238 yeast profiles across dose gradients and varying growth rates for six nominal pairs of four growth inhibitors. These are not six complete fixed-dose independent culture panels; a different organism and dose/growth contract would be required.
One ATRA/VPA pair at three times with three repeats, and a missing 72-hour control repeat. Times cannot be counted as independent same-state panels.
One elesclomol/paclitaxel pair, with two explicitly technical repeats per condition. Untreated zero-hour profiles are not six-hour vehicle controls.
One Y15/temozolomide pair in U87 with two repeats; DBTRG has only Y15. Series design states temozolomide 100 uM while sample titles state 20 uM, so physical-dose provenance is also unresolved.
12 xenograft profiles, six arms with two biological repeat labels and two BMS-754807-centered pairs. Tumor-bearing mice are not the original fixed-culture assay.

One gemcitabine/bexarotene pair in acquired-resistant Calu3 cultures after ten treatment cycles. Four RNA repeat labels and a differing parental state do not establish the original six fixed-state panels.
